description: Costco Canada (costco.ca) product tracker: for 1-5 product IDs (the number at the end of a costco.ca product URL) returns name, brand, item number (SKU), price in CAD, availability (in stock / out of stock), shipping rate, rating and rating count, category path, description, image and URL, from each public product page's schema.org data. No keyword search; costco.com (US) is not reachable from the tool's network. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ids.description: Comma-separated costco.ca product IDs or product URLs, 1 to 5, e.g. 100107807 (required)
